description: The plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and features a linear scale from 500 to 1500 with tick marks at intervals of 250, while the region between 0 and 500 contains a visual break indicated by a grey rectangle on the axis line. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with tick marks at 45, 50, and 55, representing an interval of 5. The "Squared-Exponential" line is dark blue, solid, and uses circular markers; it starts at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 0 demonstrations, rises to a peak of roughly 56.2 at 1000 demonstrations, and remains steady at 56.2 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" line is medium blue, solid, and uses circular markers; it begins at approximately 48.2 near 0 demonstrations, experiences a slight dip to 47.9 at 750 demonstrations, and ends at roughly 48.1 at 1500 demonstrations, showing a relatively steady trend overall. The "ELU" line is light purple, solid, and uses circular markers; it maintains a steady trend throughout, starting at approximately 46.4 near 0 demonstrations and ending at roughly 46.4 at 1500 demonstrations. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is pink, dash-dotted, and has no markers; it forms a constant horizontal line across the entire x-axis at an accuracy value of approximately 43.
